asset_kind: Original procedural R3F architectural card models
rights: No third-party mesh, texture, photograph, logo or downloadable model is included. Official photographs were consulted only as visual references. All runtime geometry is authored locally from primitives and thin polygon plates.
material_direction: Neutral white uncoated card, slightly grey cut edges and score lines, visible physical thickness and butt joints, blank black mounting card. No glass, metallic facade, phototexture or title label.

geometry: four upper facade strips with genuinely open horizontal window bands
open roof-garden court and scored paving
sloping promenade ramp with separate upright balustrade sheets
faceted curved solarium screen and open rectangular viewing frame
models.interpretation: Recognisable display-scale reconstruction, not a survey model. The upper building is 1.412 by 0.828 studio units; the broad blank mounting board determines the final footprint. Card sheets have deliberate joints and approximately 0.006–0.018 unit thickness.

models.building: Bank of China Tower, Hong Kong
geometry: successively lower shaft endings with sloping roof facets
separately cut triangular white-card facade panels
models.interpretation: Display-scale paper maquette. The four-prism and diagonal-frame architectural vocabulary is preserved while the real glass envelope is translated into opaque cut-card plates. Shaft roofs and width are adjusted for a legible miniature; dimensions are not asserted as a measured reproduction.

references.title: About BOC Tower
references.used_for: Architect attribution; May 1990 opening; 70 floors above ground; 315 m structure and 367.4 m total height with two masts; four prism-shaped shafts; bamboo-growth concept; official mast/triangular-frame photograph.
